trace: MCPClientSession.connect records up to8 icons from the exact connected serverInfo; loadTools admits current tool.icons and server icons into MCPToolDescriptor.
HanlinCanonicalToolAuthority stores that complete profile in its candidate/backend target; canonical descriptor projection/revision/authority does not derive from artwork.
AssistantToolBridge.PreparedTools.presentationProfile only fills canonical fields; ToolPresentationProfileRegistry returns explicit profiles unchanged.
HanlinAISDKToolAdapter captures the profile for its canonical executor and AgentToolCall; AgentEventAccumulator persists it on actual call/execution steps.
ToolActivityPresentationDescriptor adds an optional Codable field; old missing fields decode nil. New icon-set decoding skips malformed decoration entries and bounds admission/replay.
AgentActivityComposer takes the first nonnil profile icons within that call lifecycle group, preserving call grouping; AgentDisplayActivity carries it to activityRow and HanlinToolActivityHeader.

The header chooses matching/neutral tool then server artwork; same SF slot remains during failure; the task is keyed by candidate URLs and checks cancellation/current candidates before state publication.
pipeline_review.reconnect: MCPRuntimeController creates a fresh MCPClientSession per generation, replaces its catalog only for the current generation and removes old records on stop/failure. A new handshake assigns serverInfo.icons including nil; no old server artwork is consulted.
pipeline_review.loading: Shared Data/ImageIO loader retains128KiB stream cap,32px thumbnail,PNG normalization,cookies disabled,and6-second URLRequest timeout; adds central HTTPS URL admission and redirect guard. No claim that this request timeout is a separately enforced absolute resource deadline.
pipeline_review.native_limit: Network/decode/render behavior is not authenticated by the four metadata unit tests. Shared-header/loader native impact is classified for fresh UI execution rather than assumed equivalent.
